## Rule (verified 266/266 on train+test+arc-gen, batch50)

Input has two non-zero colors: one compact **shape**, one scattered **dots**. Output is always 3×3.
1. **dense (shape) color** = max fill-ratio = min column-variance. Selector `score[c] = N²·(1 − Var_col(c)/32)`; argmax picks dense.
2. **dot color** = the other present color (exclude background ch0).
3. dense bbox is **always square** (0/266 non-square).
4. output = **3×3 strided sample** of the dense mask over its bbox (stride K=side/3), rendered in the dot color, one-hot into `(1,10,30,30)` uint8 at top-left. Empty cells carry **ch0=1** (grader requires a full one-hot; argmax-only output fails visible 0/266).

## Algorithm sketch
```python
c = [k for k in 1..9 if (g==k).any()]                 # exactly 2
dense = argmax_c( count(c) / bbox_area(c) )            # ≡ min col-variance
dot   = the other color
r0,r1,c0,c1 = bbox(g==dense)                           # always square: r1-r0==c1-c0
K = (r1-r0+1)//3
out[i,j] = dot if (g==dense)[r0+iK, c0+jK] else 0      # i,j in 0..2
```

## Cost analysis
LIVE cost 891 = memory 743 + params 148 (staged pad_axes 890 = 743+147). Dominant charged intermediates (input/output are FREE):
- 2× F32 row/col marginals `(1,30)` = **240 B** (Einsum outputs, needed for bbox).
- occupancy bool+uint8 ×2 = **120 B** (uint8 mandatory: ArgMax rejects BOOL).
- `(1,10,3,3)` output one-hot uint8 = **90 B**.
- selector/present `(1,10)` F32 + sampled `(1,1,3,3)` + int32 bbox arithmetic + concats ≈ **~290 B**.
- params: A_f/B_f `[2,30]` = **120** (rank-2 variance selector is minimal; moving moments out trades 60 params for ~240 mem = net loss).

## Don't-do log
- **Do NOT retarget ~400.** Infeasible; LIVE is already marginal+crop. Forced floor ≈ memory 743 + params 147 = 890.
- **Do NOT build BOOL→ArgMax variants** (ORT rejects ArgMax(BOOL); uint8 occupancy hop is mandatory).
- **Do NOT output argmax-only (skip ch0)** — grader requires full one-hot; empty cells need ch0=1 (visible 0/266 without it).
- **Do NOT split the rank-2 selector into separate M1/M2 moment reductions** — saves 60 params but adds ~240 B memory (net +180).
- **Do NOT chase per-color spatial features** (per-color marginal / erosion / conv) — each materialises a `(1,10,30,·)` ≥1,200 B tensor, blowing the budget.
- The only sub-890 move is a 2-byte initializer dedup (888) — an epsilon shave, deliberately not staged.
